notes: Replication locator p.5 selects Study 1. Original target is its nine-month-old Social-condition box-opening choice test, explicitly identified in replication introduction and Participants. Original full text verified by title via PMC; HTML section locators used because PDF alternatives did not yield parseable PDFs. Original reports binomial choice counts and p but no scalar test statistic or explicitly numerical effect size for this age-specific test; original es left null without conversion. Replication percentage is printed by the authors and matches the same Study 1 choice test; no numerical binomial statistic printed. No values derived.
